name: Force HPET
description: Forces Windows to use the High Precision Event Timer (HPET) as the system clock. This may improve timing consistency on older systems but can increase latency or reduce performance on modern gaming PCs.

description_i18n.en: Forces Windows to use the High Precision Event Timer (HPET) as the system clock. This may improve timing consistency on older systems but can increase latency or reduce performance on modern gaming PCs.
description_i18n.de: Erzwingt, dass Windows den High Precision Event Timer (HPET) als Systemuhr verwendet. Dies kann auf älteren Geräten die Zeitkonsistenz verbessern, führt aber bei modernen Gaming-PCs oft zu höherer Latenz oder geringerer Leistung.
description_i18n.fr: Force Windows à utiliser le minuteur HPET comme horloge système. Cela peut améliorer la précision du timing sur les anciens systèmes mais augmente souvent la latence ou réduit les performances sur les PC gaming modernes.

warnings.title: Boot configuration modified
warnings.message: This tweak updates boot configuration values that affect startup behavior and system timing sources

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the boot configuration registry value useplatformclock to Yes or removes it
